  --stack-bank: select WRAM window used for initial CPU stack
  --stack-top: initial SP value inside selected stack window
  --stack-reserve: reserve N bytes below stack top from automatic placement

  battery-run      Cold boot with an explicit battery file; no implicit save-file writes

Usage: kurosaki.exe decompile [OPTIONS] <ROM>

Arguments:
  <ROM>  

Options:
      --out <OUT>
          Write the rendered report here; stdout is used when omitted
      --format <FORMAT>
          [default: json] [possible values: json, markdown, text]
      --function <FUNCTIONS>
          Function name or Bnnn:$AAAA physical PRG-bank selector. Repeatable
      --all
          Also start a bounded candidate analysis at $8000 in every physical 8 KiB PRG bank
      --annotations <ANNOTATIONS>
          JSON annotation sidecar. ROM.decompile.json is loaded automatically when present
      --snapshot <SNAPSHOT>
          Restore a version-2 snapshot before capturing the PRG-bank windows
      --trace-jsonl <TRACE_JSONL>
          KUROSAKI trace JSONL to overlay exact physical-bank/PC hit counts
      --max-instructions <MAX_INSTRUCTIONS>
          Per-function static-analysis cap, preventing data from causing unbounded output [default: 2048]
  -h, --help
          Print help

Usage: sarakura.exe gb analyze [OPTIONS] --metadata <METADATA> --events <EVENTS> --out <OUT>

Options:
      --metadata <METADATA>
          
      --events <EVENTS>
          
      --out <OUT>
          
      --frames <FRAMES>
          [default: 300]
      --diagnostic-summary-limit <DIAGNOSTIC_SUMMARY_LIMIT>
          [default: 200]
      --diagnostic-rule <DIAGNOSTIC_RULES>
          Analyze only this event_type or catalog ID. Can be repeated
      --phase <PHASE>
          Analyze only this phase, for example MVP-1. Can be repeated
      --diagnostic-pack <DIAGNOSTIC_PACKS>
          Analyze only this diagnostic pack/domain, for example core, ppu, audio, mapper, fds. Can be repeated
      --min-severity <MIN_SEVERITY>
          Keep only diagnostics at or above this severity [possible values: error, warn, info]
      --fail-on <FAIL_ON>
          Return a non-zero exit code if diagnostics at or above this severity remain [default: never] [possible values: never, error, warn, info]
      --no-report
          Do not emit report.html
      --no-repro-bundle
          Do not emit repro_bundle.zip
      --allow-project-labels
          Preserve project build labels, paths, and source identifiers in output
  -h, --help
          Print help

Usage: sarakura.exe coverage [OPTIONS] --events <EVENTS> <PLATFORM>

Arguments:
  <PLATFORM>  [possible values: gb, fc]

Options:
      --events <EVENTS>  
      --out <OUT>        Optional path to write catalog coverage JSON. If a directory is given, diagnostic_coverage.json is created inside it
      --json             Emit JSON to stdout instead of a compact text summary
  -h, --help             Print help

Usage: sarakura.exe pack-plan [OPTIONS] <PLATFORM>

Arguments:
  <PLATFORM>  [possible values: gb, fc]

Options:
      --out <OUT>  Optional path to write pack plan JSON. If a directory is given, diagnostic_pack_plan.json is created inside it
      --json       Emit JSON to stdout instead of a Markdown summary
  -h, --help       Print help

Usage: sarakura.exe repair-plan [OPTIONS] --diagnostics <DIAGNOSTICS>

Options:
      --diagnostics <DIAGNOSTICS>  Directory containing ai_diagnostics.json, or an ai_diagnostics.json file
      --out <OUT>                  Optional path to write repair_plan.json. If omitted, JSON is printed to stdout
      --markdown <MARKDOWN>        Optional path to write repair_plan.md. If a directory is given, repair_plan.md is created inside it
  -h, --help                       Print help

Usage: sarakura.exe automation-plan [OPTIONS] --diagnostics <DIAGNOSTICS>

Options:
      --diagnostics <DIAGNOSTICS>    Directory containing ai_diagnostics.json, or an ai_diagnostics.json file
      --tool <TOOL>                  Tool name for generated commands. Use auto, kokura, or kurosaki [default: auto]
      --out <OUT>                    Optional path to write automation_plan.json. If omitted, JSON is printed to stdout
      --markdown <MARKDOWN>          Optional path to write automation_plan.md. If a directory is given, automation_plan.md is created inside it
      --capabilities <CAPABILITIES>  Optional SARAKURA tool capability JSON. Unsupported options are omitted from generated commands
  -h, --help                         Print help

Usage: sarakura.exe baseline-delta [OPTIONS] --baseline <BASELINE> --current <CURRENT>

Options:
      --baseline <BASELINE>
          Baseline directory containing ai_diagnostics.json, or an ai_diagnostics.json file
      --current <CURRENT>
          Current directory containing ai_diagnostics.json, or an ai_diagnostics.json file
      --out <OUT>
          Optional path to write baseline_delta.json. If omitted, JSON is printed to stdout
      --markdown <MARKDOWN>
          Optional path to write baseline_delta.md. If a directory is given, baseline_delta.md is created inside it
      --fail-on-new <FAIL_ON_NEW>
          Fail when new diagnostics at or above this severity are introduced [default: error] [possible values: never, error, warn, info]
      --fail-on-regression <FAIL_ON_REGRESSION>
          Fail when existing diagnostics regress at or above this severity [default: error] [possible values: never, error, warn, info]
      --enforce
          Return a non-zero exit code when the baseline policy fails
  -h, --help
          Print help

Usage: sarakura.exe schema <COMMAND>

Commands:
  export  
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help

Usage: sarakura.exe schema export [OPTIONS] --out <OUT>

Options:
      --out <OUT>            
      --manifest <MANIFEST>  
  -h, --help                 Print help

Usage: sarakura.exe inspect-repro [OPTIONS] <BUNDLE>

Arguments:
  <BUNDLE>  

Options:
      --out <OUT>  
      --json       
  -h, --help       Print help
